description: Railway — Station — Facilities is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. This dataset has been created by Brisbane City Council using information from Queensland Rail about station features, customer service hours, contact details, zone, and location. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are accessibility, facilities, queensland rail, railway, stations. The portal shows 157 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
